summary: An AIPAC endorsement, a Yea vote on the $14.3B Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Act (which contained no Palestinian humanitarian aid), and a Yea on H.R. 6090 directing the IHRA definition into education enforcement position Kean as a strong defender of Israel. He framed the conflict around the October 7 attack and labeled a Trump-brokered Israel-Hamas agreement a 'historic peace deal.' The UDP-funded 314 Action Fund spent $209,597 against his re-election.
